transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been having trouble getting my thoughts across. Like, in my artist statements and client notes, and even when I’m talking in meetings, I start jumping from textures to budgets to, I don’t know, secret meanings in things. People keep telling me they can’t really follow what I’m trying to explain, and it’s starting to affect my work.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually energized or high and needed much less sleep than usual?
Yes. There are times when I’ll work really late and only sleep maybe two or three hours, but then I wake up feeling bright and ready to keep going. I don’t feel tired like I normally would.
During those times when you slept only two or three hours, did you also feel unusually euphoric or high?

Yes. I feel kind of lit up, like I can do anything and every idea I have is a great one. But it can flip too—if someone makes even a small comment about my work, I can get really irritated or snap more than I should.
During those times when you feel lit up and need very little sleep, do you ever hear voices or become convinced of things that other people say aren’t true?

Yes. During the really charged-up work periods, when I’m barely sleeping and taking on too much, I can get convinced that things are trying to tell me what to do. Like stains on surfaces or certain phrases in emails feel like instructions. And sometimes in the studio I hear a woman’s voice commenting on what I’m doing.
Have you ever heard the voice or felt those messages were meant for you during a time when your mood was not especially high or irritable?

Yes. There was a stretch, maybe about a month, where my mood wasn’t really up like that. I was sleeping more normally and didn’t feel unstoppable. But I still heard comments, like they were coming from behind the shelves, and I kept seeing hidden warnings in normal studio materials. That went on for several weeks.
At any point, have the voices or hidden messages continued for at least two weeks when you were not feeling especially high, irritable, or depressed?

Yes. There was that quieter month when I wasn’t really high or irritable, and I wasn’t depressed either. I was sleeping more normally, but I still heard comments like they were coming from behind the shelves, and I kept reading hidden warnings into regular studio materials. That lasted several weeks.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had low stretches, but I don’t know that it was most of the day nearly every day for two full weeks. I’d have to think about that more.
Have you ever had a time when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m still not sure. I’ve had times where I felt pretty low, but I can’t say clearly that it was most of the day, almost every day, for two weeks straight.
Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have a neurological or other medical condition that could affect your brain?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t been told I have anything neurological or medical that affects my brain.
Looking across the whole time you’ve been having these experiences, have the voices or hidden messages been present during most of that time?

Yes… I think so. The hidden messages in materials, and then the voice or the smells in the studio, have been going on for about 11 months now. So, yeah, they’ve been there for most of this whole period.
Over these 11 months, have periods of feeling unusually high or irritable made up most of the time you’ve been ill?

Yes, I think so. Looking back, the times when I was really energized or irritable and getting a lot done took up more of the year than the calmer times. It wasn’t always the same intensity, but it was there a lot of the time.
